data.name: Joshita
data.gender_notes: Joshita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Joshita is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Josh', which means 'knowledge'. The suffix 'ita' denotes the feminine form. This name is associated with the goddess of knowledge and wisdom, Saraswati. The name Joshita carries the meaning “Goddess of knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Joshita usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Joshita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joshita total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
